summary: 1.0.73 macOS. 50 BB FF 20 12 07 25 handshake, ident AA 30 76 04 00 05 20 DD. Version reads and channels 0x0000-0x17C0 answered; 0x1EC0 after the channels got no reply. Same as UV-5R, BF-F8HP, UV-5RX3. UV-5RX CPS never reads the settings block after the channels. Fix: read the settings block before the channels.
